summary: Expanded the AI power-availability node with a two-lane universe focused on scarce electrical equipment, data-center electrical construction, grid/substation services, and nuclear fuel-cycle capacity. The clearest underfollowed chokepoint signals are medium-voltage switchgear and engineered electrical distribution, skilled electrical construction capacity, substation/transmission execution capacity, and HALEU/enrichment capacity for any advanced-nuclear path tied to future data-center baseload demand.
